room_rent.note: ICU: no cap. If non-ICU room rent exceeds 1% of SI/day, co-payment applies on associated medical expenses (excl. pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics) per co-payment table. Co-pay ranges 0%–25% depending on SI and room rent chosen.

icu.note: No co-payment for ICU admission even if ICU charges exceed any limit.

copayment.display: 0% base; room-upgrade co-pay 0–25%; zone co-pay up to 20%
copayment.note: Room rent co-pay on associated medical expenses (not pharmacy/consumables/implants/diagnostics) if non-ICU room exceeds 1% of SI/day. Zone co-pay: 10% (Zone 2 treating in Zone 1), 20% (Zone 3 treating in Zone 1/2).

sub_limits.note: Disease-wise sub-limits apply per Annexure 1: cataract ₹10k–₹30k/eye, CABG ₹80k–₹1.5L, PTCA ₹40k–₹1.2L, knee/hip replacement ₹40k–₹1.2L, hysterectomy ₹20k–₹45k, dialysis ₹10k–₹20k, transplant ₹80k–₹1.5L, and more. Modern treatments: 50% of SI.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12 mo: gastric ulcers, urinary/biliary stones, ear/tonsil surgery. 24 mo: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, sinuses, DNS, fistula, haemorrhoids, hysterectomy, tumours/cysts, varicose veins etc. 36 mo: organ transplant, joint replacement (degenerative).

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; reduces by 10% per claim year; max 50% of base SI.

restoration.note: Recharge benefit: 100% of basic SI reinstated once per policy year after full exhaustion. Available for SI ≥₹3L. Applicable for same or different ailment.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses capped at 1% of SI (excl. cumulative bonus).

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses capped at 1% of SI (excl. cumulative bonus).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation for accident and illness covered. Preventive/rejuvenation treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting surgery costs covered under recipient's policy. Subject to transplant sub-limit in Annexure 1.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments capped at 50% of SI per policy period. Proportionate room rent deduction also applies.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment in India only.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary treatment, OPD, dental (non-accidental), maternity, infertility/ART, stem cell storage, treatment outside India, many disease sub-limits apply
